skills.name: qspintn-bayesian-optimization
skills.description: Choose QSpinTN and MATLAB Bayesian optimization settings for exploration, refinement, parallel evaluations, stalled fits, loss-scale changes and verified continuation.

skills.name: qspintn-model-building
skills.description: Build and validate QSpinTN spin Hamiltonians and interaction maps for chains, two-dimensional lattices or arbitrary finite graphs, including one-dimensional site ordering, parameter constraints and the distinction between magnetic fields and on-site interactions.

skills.name: qspintn-ed
skills.description: Use QSpinTN exact diagonalization for small finite spin systems, thermal benchmarks, and high-temperature model exploration.

skills.name: qspintn-iltrg
skills.description: Use QSpinTN iLTRG for spin-1/2 nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor chain thermodynamics, including J1-J2 and directed DM terms, and assess grouping, Trotter, bond-dimension and output-grid limitations.

skills.name: qspintn-xtrg
skills.description: Use QSpinTN XTRG for finite-MPO thermodynamics, including SETTN initialization, temperature grids, and convergence checks.

skills.name: qspintn-tantrg
skills.description: Use QSpinTN tanTRG for imaginary-time thermal MPO evolution and assess step schedules, truncation, and derived heat capacity.

skills.name: qspintn-dmrg
skills.description: Use QSpinTN one-site, two-site or hybrid DMRG for ground states, filename-based MPS warm starts, memory or disk environments and convergence diagnostics.

skills.name: qspintn-dynamics
skills.description: Use QSpinTN real-time TDVP for ground-state correlation dynamics, including MPS preparation, momentum operators, time units, and saving hooks.

skills.name: qspintn-method-selection
skills.description: Select an appropriate QSpinTN many-body method from observable, geometry, temperature, and convergence needs.

skills.name: qspintn-units
skills.description: Convert QSpinTN Cm, susceptibility and M-H data between natural, SI and CGS units; identify per-spin, molar and mass normalization from solver outputs and experimental metadata.
